text.p: Counterinsurgency troops killed five leftist rebels in two separate clashes and seized weapons, grenades and land mines, in northeastern Colombia, military sources said on Sunday.

The first battle between the army and the National Liberation Army, the country's second-largest rebel force, took place on Friday night in Norte de Santander province. Four guerrillas were killed as soldiers foiled a rebel extortion plot.
The fifth ELN rebel died in a battle on Saturday in Arauca province.
An imprisoned ELN leader, Francisco Galan, was meanwhile transferred from Itagui prison in the northwest to Bogota's top-security Modelo jail, prison authorities said.

No reason for the transfer was given, but the ELN and the larger Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) guerrilla army have staged several attacks on jails and freed jailed comrades. Galan, the ELN's No. 3, is serving 30 years for extortion, rebellion and terrorism.
